question: Which of the following options is NOT one of the meanings of the homonym 'condition'?

options.text: To improve the hardness and elasticity of things
The physical state of something or someone
To train someone to behave in a certain way
A requirement that must be met for something to happen

solution:
The correct answer is: **1 i.e. To improve the hardness and elasticity of things**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"condition"** has multiple meanings depending on the context in which it is used.
 
• One of its meanings refers to **"to improve the hardness and elasticity of things"**. However, this specific meaning is not commonly associated with the primary interpretations of the word "condition" in general language usage. (चीजों की कठोरता और लोच में सुधार करना)
 
 
• **Example:** The metal was conditioned to withstand extreme temperatures.
 
 
• Another common meaning of "condition" is **"a requirement that must be met for something to happen."** (शर्त)
 
 
• **Example:** The loan will be approved under the condition that you provide collateral.
 
 
• Hence, the meaning "To improve the hardness and elasticity of things" is not one of the primary meanings associated with the word "condition."

Therefore, the correct answer is: **1 i.e. To improve the hardness and elasticity of things**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **2. The physical state of something or someone (स्थिति):** Refers to the current state or condition of a person or object.
 
 
• **Example:** The car is in excellent condition after the repairs.
 
 
 
• **3. To train someone to behave in a certain way (शिक्षित करना):** Refers to teaching or training someone to act in a particular manner.
 
 
• **Example:** Soldiers are conditioned to follow orders without hesitation.
 
 
 
• **4. A requirement that must be met for something to happen (शर्त):** Indicates a stipulation or prerequisite for an event or action.
 
 
• **Example:** One condition for joining the club is paying the membership fee.
